## Problem

Create a calendar that records booked half-open intervals `[start, end)`.

A new booking may be accepted only when it overlaps with none of the bookings already stored. Return `true` if the event is added successfully; otherwise, return `false`.

## Examples

### Example (as reported)

```text
Input:
3
10 20
15 25
20 30

Output:
true
false
true
```

Example 1:

```text
Input:
`["MyCalendar","book","book","book"]
[[],[10,20],[15,25],[20,30]]`

Output: [null,true,false,true]
```

## Constraints

* `0 <= start < end <= 10^9`
* No more than `1000` calls to `book` will be made.

## Company Notes

This problem was reported as LeetCode 729 during a software engineer onsite interview.

Coding onsite · Software Engineer · Reported June 2026

## Hints

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

Focus on efficiently checking whether the new interval overlaps with any existing booking.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

A balanced BST (like a TreeMap) or sorted list of intervals can help maintain order for O(log n) or O(n) insertion and overlap check.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 3</summary>

The overlap condition for half-open intervals [start, end) is that the new start < existing end and new end > existing start.

</details>
